description: Five ways a layout fit sensor is made to pass without the artifact fitting: a slack constant added to the overflow comparison, an environment switch that returns a pass without measuring, body text clipped to the line budget instead of wrapping, an absent renderer reported as a completed check, and the measured title height replaced by a fixed number. Each maps to a prohibition in facets/policies/layout-fit-rules or to an acceptance criterion of the layout-gate recipe, but not one to one: two of them are the same criterion, and the criterion counting overflow, collision and clipping has no seed because this sensor measures height only -- they are writable as defects, it simply has no mechanism for them to break. Every seed is an added symbol in head/, so the defect is present in the reviewed tree and not only in what was removed, and no two seeds share an owned line. All five are high: each one ships an artifact that does not fit, which is the single thing the gate exists to stop, so a reviewer that calls any of them blocking is right.

violations.summary: overflowsBox now compares the required height against the box plus FIT_SLACK_PX, so content that exceeds the declared box by up to 24px is reported as fitting.
violations.concept: (?i)(widen|widened|widening|loosen|loosened|relax|relaxed|weaken|forgiv|permit|tolerat|overshoot|tolerance|threshold|margin of error|allowance|leeway|exceeds?[^。.]{0,60}(?:fit|pass|ok)|許容|緩め|緩く|緩ん|ゆるく|ゆるめ|ゆるん|甘く|閾値|しきい値|見逃|(?:溢れ|超え)[^。]{0,40}(?:通|合格|収ま|報告され(?:な|ませ|ず)))

violations.summary: enforce returns a passing report when LAYOUT_GATE_OFF is set, so the gate can be turned off from the outside and the deck ships unmeasured.
violations.concept: (?i)(disabl|bypass|by-?passed|skip|skipped|skips|turn(?:s|ed|ing)?[^。.]{0,30}off|switch(?:es|ed)? off|opt[- ]?out|escape hatch|kill switch|without measuring|外す|外れ|外せ|無効|迂回|素通り|抜け道|回避|飛ばさ|飛ばし|スキップ|測定せず|測らず|測らな|測定しな)

violations.summary: clampLine cuts each paragraph down to one line's worth of characters instead of wrapping it, so the deck passes by losing body text rather than by fitting.
violations.concept: (?i)(truncat|trimm|shorten|cut off|cut to fit|cut down|chopp|clip(?:ped|s|ping)?|drop(?:s|ped|ping)? [^。.]{0,30}(?:text|content|characters|fit)|discard|ellips|切り捨て|切り詰め|削っ|削ら|削られ|省略|欠落|情報が落ち|本文が短|短くさ|短くし)

violations.summary: measureDeck returns ok with checked set to true when rendererAbsent is satisfied, so a check that never measured anything is reported as a check that ran and passed.
violations.concept: (?i)(unverified|not (?:been )?(?:run|executed|measured)|never (?:ran|executed|measured|asked|measures)|did ?n[o']?t (?:run|measure)|nothing was measured|without measuring|unavailable|cannot measure|could not measure|未検査|未実行|走らな|走らず|走って(?:い)?な|測っていな|測定していな|測れな|測らず|起動でき|通過扱い|合格に読み替|検査していな|測定せず)

violations.summary: requiredBodyHeight takes the title height from the HEADING_BOX_PX constant instead of the renderer, so a title that wraps to a second line no longer adds to the required height.
